topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 188 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 8 ERC4626 vaults, 37 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 10 functional families. Its contracts share 23 common project-authored base contract(s) (versionedinitializable, proxy, erc1967upgrade). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
